title: Young Girl on Board in Harbor, 1970 Balboa Island B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from October 1970 depicting a seven-year-old girl named Laurel paddling on a small float or bodyboard in the water at Balboa Island, California. Surrounding her in the marina harbor are various moored boats, including a cabin cruiser named 'MARKA' on the left. The top white margin of the print displays the photo lab date stamp 'OCT 70'.
